en: Being thus addressed, Dhananjaya replied to the pious and intelligent (Yudhishthira) having honoured him as if he were his spiritual guide.

sa: मनोरमां वाचमुदीरयन्तः। स्तस्मिन् वने बर्हिणकोकिलाश्च॥
en: And peacocks, Datyuhas, Chakoras, Barhins and Kokilas sat on the top of the highest trees and emitted their sweet notes. saw

sa: यथोपजोषमासीनाः पुन तप्रवृत्तये। सर्वलोकविनाशाय दैवेनोपनिपीडिताः॥
en: Guided by Fate, they once more sat down at ease for gambling in order to bring about the destruction of men.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच विवादितोऽसौ न हि मादृशैर्हि सिंहीकृतस्तेन वदत्यभीतः। समेत्य मां निहतः शेष्यतेऽद्य मार्गे भग्नं शकटमिवाचलाक्षम्॥
en: Ashtavakra said : Bandi has never had an occasion to hold a discussion with a man like me. It is only for this reasor, that he considers himself as a lion and goes about roaring like one. But when he will meet me today, he will lie down (dead) as a cart breaks down on the road when its wheels have been deranged.

sa: तदहं वज्रसंकाशैर्महेन्द्रास्त्रप्रचोदितैः। अचूर्णयं वेगवद्भिः शरजालैर्महाहवे॥
en: Thereupon, at that terrible encounter, I crushed (those crags) with showers of fleet arrows, resembling the thunderbolt, discharged from Mahendra's weapon.

sa: विन्ध्यपर्वतजैर्मतैः पूर्णा हैमवतैरपि। मदान्वितैरतिबलैर्मातङ्गैः पर्वतोपमैः॥
en: With fierce elephants sprung on the Vindhya mountain, and the Himavat, filled with juice, and of exceeding strength, and resembling hills.

sa: तौ तमाश्रममासाद्य द्रुमैबहुभिरावृतम्। सुरम्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ शबरीमभ्युपेयतुः॥
en: Getting at that charming hermitage covered on all sides with trees and casting their looks around they beheld that female mendicant-Savari.

sa: सर्वर्तुकांश्च देशेषु वानराः सफलदुमान्। आसाद्य रजनी शय्यां चक्रुः सर्वेष्वहःसु ते॥
en: In every place, by day coming to trees aye enjoying every season, and crowned with fruits, the monkeys prepared their beds at night.* *The sense is rather obscure, it being difficult to understand the relation their beds bore to the neighbouring trees.

sa: तावाहूतौ नरव्याघ्रौ वैदेह्या रामलक्ष्मणौ। वीक्षमाणौ तु तं देशं तदा ददृशतुर्मंगम्॥
en: Having called (her husband) again and again in this strain she continued beholding that deer. Being thus called by the daughter of the king of Videha those two best of men Rāma and Laks maņa, casting their looks around beheld that deer.

sa: तूर्णमुत्पत्य चाकाशमादित्यपतमास्थितौ। आवामालोकयावस्तद् वनं शाद्वलसंस्थितम्॥
en: And swiftly darting up into the sky and approaching the path of the Sun, we saw a wood interspersed with swards.

sa: श्वगृध्रकङ्ककाकोलभासगोमायुवायसाः। अतृप्यंस्तत्र वीराणां हतानां मांसशोणितैः॥
en: Dogs, heroes, ravens, crows, falcons, jackals and vultures feasted on the flesh and blood of the heroes killed in the battle-field.

sa: प्रशान्तभृकृटिः श्रीमान् कृता शान्तिः कुलस्य नः।।१२ तमभ्येत्य सहामात्यः परिष्वज्य नृपात्मजम्।
en: And with the wrinkles of rage smoothed down, and looking happy as if endued with prosperity then will the peace of our race have been effected. Having gone to him with your ininisters and embracing that son of a ruler of men.

sa: पात्रं प्रतिग्रहस्यायं दातुं पात्रं तथा भवान्। शो क्षीरमिवासिक्तं भवत्वेतत् तथोपमम्॥
en: He is a fit party to receive gifts and you too are a fit party to make presents, and the present that you now make to him will be like milk kept in deposit in a conch shell (available at any moment).

sa: इदं ह्यद्य कुलं श्रेष्ठं सर्वराजसु पार्थिव। श्रुतवृत्तोपसम्पन्नं सर्वैः समुदितं गुणैः॥
en: 0 ruler of the earth, this dynasty (of yours) is the best among these of all kings; it is noted for its knowledge of the scriptures as also for its good ways of life and it is endued with all the virtues.

sa: माशंसते धार्तराष्ट्रो विजेतुम्। सदा ह्येनं तर्कयते दुरात्मा तच्चाप्ययं सहतेऽस्मान् समीक्ष्य॥
en: The son of Dhritarashtra aspires to vanquish this Vishnu, who cannot be withstood in fight and who is of endless strength; and that one of wicked soul is ever trying to imprison him. This Krishna however endures even this for our sake.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रक्षो रावणः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥ अभव्यो भव्यरूपेण भस्मच्छन्न इवानलः। यतिवेषप्रतिच्छन्नो जिहीर्षुस्तामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: In the meantime, the Rakshasa Ravana appeared (before Sita). Assuming a gentele appearance though inwardly very wicked and like a fire hidden under ashes. Disguised as an ascetic he (showed himself there) in order to carry off that lady of blameless character.

sa: यदर्जुनस्यर्षभतुल्यगामिनः पुराभवत् खाण्डवदाहमङ्गलम्। कुरून् समासाद्य रणे बृहन्नले सहोत्तरेणाद्य तदस्तु मङ्गलम्॥
en: "(They said) 0 Brihannala, may that victory, which Arjuna, walking like a bull obtained in the days of yore at the time of the burning of the forest of Khandava, come to you today when you shall with Uttara meet the Kurus.

sa: गुर्वर्थोऽयं समारम्भो न हयैः कृत्यमस्ति मे। यदि शक्यं महाराज क्रियतामविचारितम्॥
en: For the sake of my spiritual guide that do I make these efforts for the horses and it is not for myself; if you are prepared to act thus, O great king, do what I have said without any reflection or hesitation.

sa: एते ह्यपि यथैवाहं मन्तुमर्हसि तांस्तथा। सर्वे धर्मविदो ह्येते तुल्यस्नेहाश्च भारत॥
en: These stand in the same relation to you as I myself and it is proper that you should regard them in the same light. All of them know what virtue is and have the same degree of affection for you, O Bharata.

sa: भुजङ्गाभोगवासेन श्रोणिसूत्रेण राजता। विभ्राजसे चाबद्धेन भोगेनेवेह मन्दरः॥ ध्वजेन शिखिपिच्छानामुच्छ्रितेन विराजसे।
en: With a beautiful crown and graceful tresses, with dresses made of the hoods of serpents and an ornament fascinating your hip, you appear to be like the mount Mandara girded with serpents; also you shine with peacock-plumes standing high on your crest.

sa: नकुलं त्वभिसंधाय क्षेमङ्करमहामुखौ। उभावुभयतस्तीक्ष्णैः शरवर्षैरवर्षताम्॥
en: Then singling out Nakula, the two heroes Kshemankara and Mahamukha began to hurl at him from both sides with keen-edged arrows.

sa: अनीर्षुर्गुप्तदारः स्याच्चोक्षः स्यादघृणी नृपः। स्त्रियः सेवेत नात्यर्थं मृष्टं भुञ्जीत नाहितम्॥
en: He should not entertain malice. He should protect his married wives. He should be pure and should not always be exercised by compassion. He should not seek too much female companionship. He should take wholesome food and never that which is bad.

sa: ऋक्षवर्णाञ्जघानाश्वान् भोजो भीमस्य संयुगे। सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थाद्धताश्वात् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥ कालो दण्डमिवोद्यम्य गदापाणिरयुध्यत।
en: The chief of the Bhojas then killed he brown horses of Bhimasena's car in that encounter. The son of Pandu, deprived of his horses, alighting from his car, began to fight with his mace, like the Destroyer himself with his uplifted bludgeon.

sa: संजय उवाच मवस्थिताः कुरवो भिन्नसेनाः। विद्युत्प्रकाशं दद्दशुः समन्ताद् धनंजयास्त्रं समुदीर्यमाणम्॥
en: Sanjaya said The broken Kaurava army, when melting away out of fear as wrathful Arjuna began his shots but halted and looked back from a distance at Arjuna's blazing weapon which resembled lightning and was coursing on all sides with increasing energy.

sa: अपि त्यागं बुभूषेत कच्चिद् गच्छेदनामयम्। सिद्धेनौषधियोगेन सर्वशत्रुविनाशिना। नागानश्वान् मनुष्यांश्च कृतकैरुपघातयेत्॥
en: Your enemy will then desire to adopt renunciation and retire into the woods seeking liberation. You will then, with the help of drugs prepared by boiling highly efficacious herbs and plants, and of artificial salts, kill the elephants and horses and men.

sa: अथवा तदुपादानात् प्राप्नुयात् कर्मणः फलम्। दण्डशस्त्रकृतं पापं पुरुषे तन्न विद्यते॥
en: Or, if it be said that, the axe being only the material cause, the consequence of the act should attach to the animate agent, then the sin visits to the person who has made the axe. This, however, can scarcely be true.

sa: श्रद्धेयः कथितो ह्यर्थं: सज्जनश्रवणं गतः। चिरं तिष्ठति मेदिन्यां शैले लेख्यामिवार्पितम्॥
en: Anything, however, that is recited by pious persons and that is heard from those who are good, deserves to be accepted with respect and faith. Such discourses exist on Earth for a long time and will last like characters engraved on rocks.

sa: ज्ञानेन तपसा चैव धीराः पश्यन्ति तत् परम्। निर्णिक्तमनसः पूता व्युत्क्रान्तरजसोऽमला:॥
en: It is by knowledge and penance that those gifted with wisdom see that which is the highest. Indeed, they who are of unsullied minds, who are purged of every sin, and who have transcended all passion and darkness (succeed in seeing it.)

sa: एवमेतत् पुरा वृत्तं तस्य यज्ञे महात्मनः। देवश्रेष्ठस्य लोकादौ वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम्॥
en: This is what took place in days of your in that sacrifice of the great Mahadeva, that foremost, one of all the celestials, in the beginning of creation, when he for the purposes of his sacrifice had assumed the form of Varuna.

sa: यथाप्सु पतितः शक्र तैलविन्दुर्विसर्पति। तथा भूमिकृतं दानं सस्ये सस्ये विवर्धते॥
en: The merit of a gift of earth increases every time the earth given away bears crops for the benefit of the owner, as a drop of oil, falling upon water, is seen to extend on every side, and cover the watery surface.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शिलरतये त्रिपथानुयोगरूपान्। बहुविधमनुशास्य तथ्यरूपान् गगनतलं द्युतिमान् विवेश सिद्धः॥
en: Bhishma said The learned ascetic gifted with high soul and great slendour and crowned with success having in this manner described to that poor Brahmana observing the Shila vow, on the subject of the infinite merits of Ganga, then ascended the sky.

sa: ततस्तु द्विशते काले लभते काण्ड पृष्ठताम्॥ काण्डपृष्ठिश्चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते।
en: After a time measured by multiplying the period last named by two hundred, one is born in the race of such a Brahmana as lives by the profession of arms. There in that order one has to wander for a long period.

sa: एते न बहु मन्यन्ते न प्रवर्तन्ति चापरे। पुत्रवत् परिपाल्यास्ते नमस्तेभ्यस्तथाभयम्॥
en: Such persons and others never pay their regards to the giver. Nor do they try for obtaining gifts. They should, however, be maintained by givers as they maintain their own sons. I bend my head to them. From them also proceeds fearlessness.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच तामपानः पतिर्भूत्वा तस्मात् प्रेषत्यपानताम्। तां गतिं मनसः प्राहुर्मनस्तस्मादपेक्षते॥
en: The Apana air, becoming the lord, on account of such lordship over it, makes it at one with itself. That restrained motion of the Prana air has been said to be the motion of the mind. Hence the mind depends upon Prana.

sa: दुष्टान्नामिषपानं च यदन्योन्यविरोधि च। गुरु चाप्यमितं भुङ्क्तं नातिजीर्णेऽपि वा पुनः॥
en: He eats bad food or bad meat or takes bad drinks, or food that has been made up of hostile ingredients. He eats food that is heavy and more than what is beneficial, or before the food previously taken, has been digested.

sa: स किंपुरुषसंकीर्णः किंनरैश्चोपशोभितः। सिद्धविप्रनिवासैश्च समन्तादभिसंवृतः॥
en: It teemed, besides, with Kimpurushas and was adorned with Kinnaras. All around it were houses of Brahinanas crowned with ascetic success.

sa: व्रतं चरति या नित्यं दुश्चरं लघुसत्त्वया। पतिचित्ता पतिहिता सा पतिव्रतभागिनी॥
en: That woman who always observes, with a light heart, vows which are difficult of observance, whose heart is devoted to her husband, and who always seeks the behoof of her husband, is considered as entitled to share the merits of her husband.

sa: रक्षितास्मीति चोक्तं ते प्रतिज्ञा चानृता तव। ब्राह्मणस्वस्य चादानं द्विविधस्ते व्यतिक्रमः॥
en: You had sworn that you would protect (all persons in the enjoyment of their own). This oath of yours was not rigidly kept by you. You took also what belonged to a Brahmana. This has been the twofold sin, you have perpetrated.

sa: काश्मीरमण्डले नद्यो याः पतन्ति महानदम्। ता नदीः सिन्धुमासाद्य शीलवान् स्वर्गमाप्नुयात्॥
en: There ere many rivers in the country called Kashmira. All these fall into the great river called Sindhu (Indus). By bathing in these rivers one is sure to become gifted with good character and to ascend to heaven after leaving this world.

sa: ततश्चन्दनकाष्ठैश्च तथा कालीयकैरपि।॥ कालागुरुप्रभृतिभिर्गन्धैश्चोच्वाचैस्तथा। समवच्छाद्य गाङ्गेयं सम्प्रज्वाल्य हुताशनम्॥ अपसव्यमकुर्वन्त धृतराष्ट्रमुखाश्चिताम्।
en: Then covering the body of Ganga's son with sandal wood and black aloe and the dark wood and other fragrant fuel, and setting ire to the same, the Kurus, with Dhritarashtra and others, stood on the right side of the funeral pyre.

sa: स्थण्डिले शुद्धमाकाशं परिगृह्य समन्ततः। प्रविश्य च मुदा युक्तो दीक्षां द्वादशवार्षिकीम्॥
en: That man who sits and lies on the bare ground with the canopy of heaven over his head, observes the course of duties of initiation, and then renounces his body by abstaining from all food, acquires great happiness in the celestial region.

sa: सहस्रशक्तिश्च शतं शतशक्तिर्दशापि च॥ दद्यादपश्च यः शक्त्या सर्वे तुल्यफलाः स्मृताः।
en: It has been said that be who gives away a hundred, having a thousand, he who gives away ten, having a hundred, and he who gives a handful of water, having no moncy, are all equal as regards the merit they acquire.

sa: न गुरावकृतप्रज्ञे शक्यं शिष्येण वर्तितुम्। गुरोहिं दीर्घदर्शित्वं यत् तच्छिष्यस्य भारत॥
en: If the preceptor happens to happens the disciple cannot possibly behave towards him in a respectful or proper way. If the preceptor is possessed of purity and good conduct, the disciple also succeeds in acquiring conduct of the same kind, O Bharata.

sa: बलेवैरोचनस्येह त्रैलोक्यमनुशासतः। समीपमाजगामाशु शुक्रो भृगुकुलोद्वहः॥
en: Once on a time, Shukra of Bhrigu's race approached Bali the son of Virochana while he was ruling the three worlds.

sa: उपेत्य शनकैर्यान्ति न सेवन्ति रजस्वलाम्। स्वर्गतिं चैव गच्छन्ति तथैव शुभकर्मिणः॥
en: They always proceed on cars and other vehicles together. They never know their wives when the latter are in mcnses. They all act in such a way as to acquire regions of happiness hercafter. Indeed, they are always righteous in their deeds.

sa: सर्वसंन्यासधर्माणां तत्त्वज्ञानविनिश्चये। सुपर्यवसितार्थश्च निर्द्वन्द्वो नष्टसंशयः॥
en: Having made conclusions about the diverse duties connected with renunciation, he was above all pairs of opposites, and had no doubts.

sa: कथं भागहराः प्रोक्ता देवताः क्रतुषु द्विज। किमर्थं चाध्वरे ब्रह्मन्निज्यन्ते त्रिदिवौकसः॥
en: Why, O twice-born one, have the gods been said to be takers of their respective shares of sacrificial offerings presented to them with the help of Mantras in sacrifices of various kinds? Why, again, are the dwellers of heaven worshipped in sacrifices?

sa: सौवर्ण राजतं चाप यथा भाण्डं निषिच्यते। तथा निषिच्यते जन्तुः पूर्वकर्मवशानुगः॥
en: As vessels of white brass, when steeped in liquified gold or silver, get the hue of these metals, so a living creature, who is entirely dependant upon the acts of his pristine lives, takes his colour from the nature of those acts.

sa: ददृशातेऽरविन्दस्थं ब्रह्माणममितप्रभम्। सृजन्तं प्रथमं वेदांश्चतुरस्चारुविग्रहान्॥
en: They saw within it Brahman of incomparable effulgence, engaged in creating the four Vedas, each gifted with the most charming form.

sa: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोभिश्च दिव्यगन्धर्वनादितैः॥
en: A white umbrella was held over his head. And he was served by many Apsaras, and many Gandharvas sang his praise.

sa: असज्जमा वृक्षेषु शैलेषु विषयेषु च। योगयुक्तं महात्मानं यथा बाणं गुणच्युतम्।॥
en: As Shuka approached, he did not seem to touch the trees or the rocks of the mountain. Perfectly dissociated from all objects of the senses, and engaged in Yoga, the great ascetic came, resembling in speed an arrow shot off a bow.

sa: तस्माद् गुणेषु रज्येथा मा दोषेषु कथंचन। निर्गुणोऽपि हि दुर्बुद्धिरात्मन: सोऽतिरज्यते॥
en: Therefore, be attached to good qualities of every sort, but never to faults. Such is the nature of good qualities that if the most foolish person, shorn of every virtue, hears himself praised for any good quality, he becomes filled with joy.

sa: विनीतो नियताहारो ब्रह्मण्यो वेदपारगः॥ स ब्रह्मचारी तद्देश्यः सखा तस्यैव सुप्रियः।
en: Of a humble disposition, of restricted diet, devoted to the Brahmanas, well-read in ihe Vedas, and observant of Brahmacharya vows, that Brahmana had been a dear friend of Gautama and belonged to that part of the country from which Gautama had come.

sa: अक्षमायाः क्षमायाश्च प्रियाणीहाप्रियाणि च। क्षमते सम्मतः साधुः साध्वाप्नोति च सत्यवाक्॥
en: Regarding unforgiveness and forgiveness, it should be said that the quality by which an esteemed and good man puts up with both what is agreeable and disagreeable, is said to be forgiveness. This virtue may be acquired by the practice of truthfulness.

sa: परदाराभिहर्तारः परदाराभिमर्शिनः। परदारप्रयोक्तारस्ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who ravish other people's wives or have sexual intercourse with them, or assist at such sinful acts, sink in hell.

sa: गुर्वर्थमभयार्थे वा वर्जयित्वा युधिष्ठिर। येऽनृतं कथयन्ति स्म ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They, O Yudhishthira, that speak an untruth on occasions other than those when such untruth is necessary for serving the purpose of the preceptor or for giving the assurance of safety to a person in fear of his life, sink in hell.

sa: न देयमेतच्च तथानृतात्मने शठाय क्लीबाय न जिह्मबुद्धये। न पण्डितज्ञानपरोपतापिने देयं तु देयं च निबोध यादृशे॥
en: It should never be given to one who speaks falsehood, or one who is cunning or roguish, or one who has no strength of mind, or one who is of crooked understanding, or one who is jealous of men of knowledge, or one who pains others. Listen to me as I say who they are to whom this knowledge may safely be given.

sa: यथा भावावसन्ना हि नौमहाम्भसि तन्तुना। तथा मनोभियोगाद् वै शरीरं प्रचिकीर्षति॥
en: As the fisherman, when he wishes, raises with the help of his chord his boat sunk in the waters, similarly the mind by the help of Yoga contemplation, raises individual Soul sunk in the world's ocean and unliberated from consciousness of body.

sa: वृणीष्वाष्टौ वरान् कृष्ण दातास्मि तव सत्तम। ब्रूहि यादवशार्दूल यानिच्छसि सुदुर्लभान्॥
en: Do you ask for eight boons. I shall grant them, O Krishna, O best of all persons. Tell me what they are, O chief of the Yadavas. Say what you wish. You will have them, however difficult of attainment they may be.

sa: सुदर्शनं तदा तस्य लोके नाम प्रतिष्ठितम्। तज्जीर्णमभवत् तात ग्रहस्यालेषु केशव॥
en: From that time it passed by the name of Sudarshanam in all the worlds. Even that weapon, O Keshava, failed to make the least impression on the body of Hiranyakashipu's son Mandara, who appeared like an evil planet in the three worlds.

sa: वातातपसहो ग्रीष्मे न च धर्ममविन्दत। दुःखशय्याश्च विविधा भूमौ च परिवर्तते॥
en: In summer he exposed himself to the sun and the wind. Still he never took himself for one who had acquired any merit by such acts. He used to sleep on various sorts of painful beds and also on the naked earth.

sa: भूयोऽप्यमितविक्रान्तं निद्रायोगमुपागतम्॥ आत्मप्रमाणरचिते अपामुपरि कल्पिते।
en: Of immeasurable prowess, he was under Yoga-sleep, his body stretched on the waters and occupying a space as vast as itself.

sa: नापत्रपश्च युक्तश्च नियुक्तः श्रेयसे परैः। अभेत्ता परगुह्यानां तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He does not feel shame for any deficiency of his. He is very attentive. He is always engaged by others for doing what is for their behoof. He never divulges the secrets of others. For this he is everywhere adored with respect.

sa: कृतश्रमः कृतप्रज्ञो न च तृप्तः समाधितः। नित्ययुक्तोऽप्रमत्तश्च तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He has worked hard in subjects worthy of hard application. He has acquired knowledge and wisdom. He is never satiate with yoga. He is always attentive and ready for work. He is ever careful. For this he is everywhere adored with respect.

sa: वृणीष्वाष्टौ वरान् कृष्ण दातास्मि तव सत्तम। ब्रूहि यादवशार्दूल यानिच्छसि सुदुर्लभान्॥
en: Do you ask for eight boons. I shall grant them, O Krishna, O best of all persons. Tell me what they are, O chief of the Yadavas. Say what you wish. You will have them, however difficult of attainment they may be.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच यदि प्राणयते वायुर्वायुरेव विचेष्टते। श्वसित्याभाषते चैव तस्माज्जीवो निरर्थकः॥
en: Bharadwaja said If it is the air that keeps us alive, if it is the air that makes us inove and act is if it, the air that makes us breathe and speak, then it appears that life is not worth much.

sa: इमं गुणसमाहारमात्मभावेन पश्यतः। असम्यग्दर्शनैर्दुःखमनन्तं नोपशाम्यति॥
en: That person who considers this union of perishable attributes as the Soui, feeis, on account of such imperfect knowledge, unending misery

sa: जानृग्वेदविनीतस्य नायजुर्वेदधारिणः। नासामवेदविदुषः शक्यमेवं विभाषतुिम्॥
en: None can speak thus who has not mastered the Rgveda, borne well the Yajurveda and acquainted himself thoroughly with the ſāyamveda.

sa: कर्णपाण्डवनिर्मुक्तैर्निर्मुक्तैरिव पन्नगैः। प्रासतोमरसंघातैः खङ्गैश्च सपरश्वधैः॥
en: Shot by Bhima and Karna and resembling snakes just freed from their sloughs; with numerous lances, javelins, swords and battle axes.

sa: त्वं गतिः सर्वसांख्यानां योगिनां त्वं परायणम्। अनावृतार्गलद्वारं त्वं गतिस्त्वं मुमुक्षुताम्॥
en: You are the refuge of all Sankhyas (the followers of Sankhya philosophy) and you are the support of all Yogins (the followers of Yoga philosophy). You are the door with bolts : unfastened, you are the refuge of men aspiring to salvation.

sa: तस्याप्यतुलनिर्घोषो बहुतोरणचित्रितः। ऋक्षचर्मावनद्धाङ्गो नल्वमात्रो महारथः॥
en: His spacious chariot also emitted unequalled clatter and was adorned with numerous arches and covered with bear-skins and measured a Nalva.

sa: तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महावी? समाश्वस्तौ नरर्षभौ। बलिनौ वारणौ यद्वद्वासितार्थे मदोत्कटौ॥
en: Indeed, when those two highly energetic warriors, those two foremost of men, both possessed of great strength, once more met each other after having rested a little, they looked like two infuriate elephants attacking each other for obtaining an elephants in season.

sa: तथा भाद्रपदे मासि हृषीकेशेति पूजयन्। सौत्रामणिमवाप्नोति पूतात्मा भवते च हि॥
en: By observing a fast on the twelfth day of the moon in the month of Bhadrapada and adoring Krishna as Hrishikesha for the whole day and night, one acquires the merits of the sautramani sacrifice and becomes purged off of all sins.

sa: अङ्गदेनेन्द्रजित्सार्धं वालिपुत्रेण राक्षसः। अयुध्यत,महातेजास्त्र्यम्बकेण यथान्धकः॥
en: And as Andhaka had combated with the Three-eyed (deity), That Raksasas, the exceedingly energetic Indrajit, faught with Angada, Son to Vāli.

sa: यदा तु मन्यतेऽन्योऽहमन्य एष इति द्विजः। तदा स केवलीभूतः षड्विंशमनुपश्यति॥
en: When the Individual Soul succeeds in apprehending that it is one, and Nature with which it lives is another, then only does it, O twice-born one, succeed in seeing the Supreme Soul and attaining to the condition of Oneness with the universe.

sa: मानुषं कृषणं राममेकं शाखामृगाश्रयम्। समर्थ मन्यसे केन त्यक्तं पित्रा वनाश्रयम्।४।।
en: A (mere) man, and feeble, and alone, and having monkeys for his support, why do you deem Rāma, who has (further) been cast off by his sire, and has in consequence taken refuge in the woods, as competent (to cope with me)?

sa: सौवर्णस्तु महांस्तस्याः प्राकारो दुष्प्रधर्षणः। मणिविद्रुमवैदूर्यमुक्ताविरचितान्तरः॥
en: She has a mighty impassable golden wall, having its side emblazoned in the centre with costly stones, coral, lapises and pearls.

sa: एषोऽतिकायो बलवान्राक्षसानामथर्षभः। स रावणसुतो धीमान्देवदानवदर्पहा॥
en: This one is Atikāya-foremost of Raksasas; and that son of Rāvana is the humbler of the hauteur of deities and Dänavas.

sa: तुषभक्षं तु मां ज्ञात्वा प्रविविक्तजने गृहे। बिभ्रतं गार्दभं रूपमागत्य परिगर्हसे॥२३॥
en: Have you come here to condemn me, having come to know that I am now assuming the form of an ass that lives upon chaff and that is now passing his days in a lonely spot remote from the dwellings of men.

sa: अप्रदाता पिता वाच्यो वाच्यश्चानुपयन् पतिः। मृते भर्तरि पुत्रश्च वाच्यो मातुररक्षिता॥
en: That father who does not give away his daughter in marriage, is blamed. That husband who does not enjoy his wife during her courses is also blamed. And that son, who does not maintain his mother in her widowhood, meets with disgrace.

sa: न ते भयं नरव्याघ्र दंष्ट्रिभ्यः शत्रुतोऽपि वा। ब्रह्मविद्भ्यश्च भविता मत्प्रसादान्नराधिप॥
en: O best of kings! O ruler of men! (hitherto fore) you shall have no fear either from the animals with fangs or from your cnemies or the Brahmanas conversant with the texts of the Vedas; for I am most graceful to you.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः कर्ण पुरस्कृत्य त्वदीया युद्धदुर्मदाः। पुनरावृत्य संग्रामं चक्रुर्देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon the troops on your side who were most invincible in battle, having placed Karna in the front part (of the army) and returning back, engaged in a battle that looked like the war between the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: अथैनं वाग्भिरुग्राभिस्रासयांचक्रिरे तदा॥ उद्यतैर्बहुभि।रैरायुधैः शोणितोक्षितैः।
en: These then tried to frighten Karna by their fierce yells. With many dreadful weapons ready for use and steeped in blood.

sa: द्वादश्यां मार्गशीर्षे तु अहोरात्रेण केशवम्। अाश्वमेधं प्राप्नोति दुष्कृतं चास्य नश्यति॥
en: That man who fasts on the twelfth day of the moon in the month called Margashira and adores Krishna as Keshava for the whole day and night, acquires the merits of the Horse sacrifice and becomes purged off of all his sins.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणुष्वावहितो राजशुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः! क्षणं च कुरु राजेन्द्र सम्प्रवक्ष्याम्यशेषतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, (first) purify yourself and (then) withdrawing your mind from all (the worldly) objects, (at that appointed hour) hear it with all attention. O king of kings, appoint a time. I shall (then) tell you everything in detail.

sa: निर्विशेषा जनपदास्तथा विष्टिकरार्दिताः। आश्रमानुपलस्यन्ति फलमूलोपजीविनः॥
en: All distinctions among men disappear. With honorary tasks and offices, men go to the forests and live on fruits and roots.

sa: भीमचापच्युतैर्बाणैस्तव सैन्यमरिंदम। अवध्यत चमूमध्ये घोरैराशीविषोपमैः॥
en: O subduer of foes, shot from Bhima's bow, shafts resembling dreadful snakes, began to slay your troops amidst your own army.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु संशितात्मा यतव्रतः। सहस्रमेकपादेन ततो ध्याने व्यतिष्ठत॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Indra, Matanga refused to hear what he was commanded. On the other hand, with regulated vows and purified soul, he practised austerer penances by standing on one foot for a thousand years, being deeply engaged in Yoga-meditation.

sa: तत् तृतीयं हनुमतो दृष्ट्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। साधुसाध्विति भूतानि प्रशशंसुस्तदा हरिम्॥
en: Witnessing that third act* The third feat, remarks Rāmānuja, is Hanuman's issuing out of Surasā's mouth. The preceding two are not mentioned. — of Hanumān's hard to perform, all beings extolled the monkey exclaiming, "Excellent! Excellent!" *A kind of also or agallochum.-Wilson.

sa: अवतीर्य विमानाच्च हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। चिन्तामुपजगामाथ शोकोपहतचेतनः॥
en: Descending from the aerial car, Hanumān, son to the Wind-god, his senses deprived by sorrow, was again wrought up with anxiety.

sa: आत्मानं खादतानार्या न सीतां भक्षयिष्यथ। जनकस्य सुतामिष्टां स्नुषां दशरथस्य च॥
en: O vile demons, do youeat your own persons (The proper expression, I think, should be-“Eat me.” The commentator Rāmānuja explains Atmanam as your own bodies.) but do not devour Sītā, the daughter of Janaka and the esteemed daughter-in-law of the king Dasaratha.

sa: सोऽन्तर्धानगतः पापो रावणी रणकर्शितः। ब्रह्मदत्तवरो वीरो रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥ अदृश्यो निशितान्बाणान्मुमोचाशनिवर्चसः।
en: And, being handled hard in battle, and having vanished from the field, the heroic and wicked son to Răvana, who had received a boon from Brahmä, transported with passion, remaining invisible, began to discharge sharpened shafts of the splendour of the thunder-bolt.

sa: स तान्बाहुद्वयासक्तानादाय पतगानिव। प्रासादं शैलसंकाशमुत्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा॥
en: Then Angada, taking them up, who were pressed against his arms, like insects, leapt up on a palace resembling a hill.

sa: अन्तरं त्वहमासाद्य राक्षसीनामवस्थितः। शनैराश्वासयाम्यद्य संतापबहुलामिमाम्॥
en: And seizing the occasion when she shall be free from her demoniac guards, I shall console her in her dire distress.

sa: स वेश्मजालं बलवान् ददर्श व्यासक्तवैदूर्यसुवर्णजालम्। यथा महत्प्रावृषि मेघजालं विद्युत्पिनद्धं सविहङ्गजालम्॥
en: And that one endowed with strength saw that row of structures fitted up with golden windows, studded with lapis lazulis, and containing birds; like to a mass of clouds in a season of great rains, crowned with lightning, and fraught with fowls.

sa: तानानिष्टसंज्ञांश्च गतासुंश्च बृहस्पतिः। विद्याभिर्मन्त्रयुक्ताभिरोषधीभिश्चिकित्सति ॥
en: They, their senses lost, and their lives departed, Bịhaspati treated by means of his knowledge of mantras, as well with medicines.

sa: वानरैर्भीमविक्रान्तैराप्लुत्योत्प्लुत्य वेगितैः। राक्षसाः करजैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मुखेषु विनिदारिताः॥
en: Bounding again and again, the vehement monkeys endowed with terrific prowess, with their finger-nails tore up the Rākṣasas by the mouths.

sa: सन्ति चौघबलाः केचित्केचिच्छतगुणोत्तराः। अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन्हरियूथपाः॥
en: Some had the strength of numbers (of elephants); and some had strength hundred times as much. And others had immeasurable might.

sa: अथ हरिवरनाथः प्राप्तसंग्रामकीर्थिर्निशिचरपतिमाजौ योजयित्वा श्रमेण। गगनमतिविशालं लङ्घयित्वार्र्कसॊनुर्हरिगणबलमध्ये रामपार्वं जगाम ॥
en: Thus the master of the foremost monkeys, securing fame in fight, beat the night-ranger, causing him to experience fatigue. And bounding beyond the spacious sky, the offspring of the Sun came to the side of Rāma in the midst of the monkey-forces.

sa: अप्राप्तान्येव तान्याशु असंभ्रान्तस्तदार्जुनः। आयुधान्तमरारीणां जग्राहारिनिषूदनः॥
en: Not the least moved thereby the king Arjuna, the slayer of enemies, bore those weapons of the enemies of the celestials.

sa: निकृत्तशिरसः केचिद्रावणेन वलीमुखाः। केचिद्विच्छत्रहृदयाः केचिच्छ्रोत्रविवर्जिताः॥
en: And some of those heroic monkeys were bebeaded by Ravana-some had their hearts rent and others were shorn of their ears.

sa: यश्चैष शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य विद्युत्प्रभं किंकरवज्रवेगम्। मायाति योऽसौ त्रिशिरा यशस्वी॥
en: That one is the famed Trisiras, that grasping a whetted dart endowed with the splendour of lightning and having the speed of the thunder for its minister, approach, riding a bull-the best of his species-and having the appearance of the Moon himself.

sa: स चतुर्दशभिर्बाणैर्निशितैर्देहदारणैः। निर्बिभेद महावीर्यं हनूमन्तमकम्पनः॥
en: Akampana pierced Hanumān endowed with exceeding prowess with four and ten shafts, sharpened and capable of cleaving the bodies of people.

sa: एवं वीर्यबलोसिक्तैर्भूरियत्नैर्महासुरैः। पीड्यमाना मही राजन्ब्रह्माणमुपचक्रमे॥
en: O king, the earth, thus oppressed by the Asuras of great strength, energy and abundant means, thought of appealing to Brahma.

sa: नूनं मुक्तो वज्रभृता स नागो भ्रष्टो नाकान्मन्त्रविसस्तकायः। घूर्णन्नाकाशे नष्टसंज्ञोऽभ्युपैति तीव्रानि:स्वासान्निःश्वसन्पन्नगेन्द्रः॥
en: The snake has been forsaken by the wielder of thunder-bolt (Indra). his body has been disabled by our Mantras. (Behold), he is falling from the heavens, (behold) the king of snakes, deprived of his consciousness, comes rolling in the sky breathing loudly.

sa: पुत्रपौत्रवधार्तायस्तथात्रैव प्रकीर्तिता। गान्धार्याश्चापि कृष्णेन क्रोधोपशमनक्रिया॥
en: The pacification by Krishna of the wrath of Gandhari, who was greatly afflicted by the death of her sons and grandsons.

sa: अपत्यमीप्सितं मह्यं दातुमर्हसि सत्तम। शीलरूपगुणोपेतमिक्ष्वाकुकुलवृद्धये॥
en: O excellent man, you should grant me a son, I desire to have, who will posses beauty, accomplishments and good behaviour.

sa: वेलादोलानिलचलं क्षोभोद्वेगसमुच्छ्रितम्। वीचीहस्तैः प्रचलितैर्नृत्यन्तमिव सर्वतः॥
en: Moved by winds, heaving high with agitation and disturbance, it seemed to dance everywhere with uplifted hands represented by its waves.

sa: पुष्पसंच्छन्नशाखाग्रं पल्लवैरुपशोभितम्। अशोकं स्तबकैश्छन्नं रमणीयमपश्यत॥
en: A beautiful Ashoka tree, decked with immense foliage and its branches so covered with flowers that they can not be seen.

sa: तथारूपस्तथाचारस्तथावृत्तस्तथाश्रुतः। गाङ्गेयस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभून्नाम्ना देवव्रतो वसुः॥
en: Shantanu's son, the Vasu, born of Ganga, named Devavrata, resembled his father in beauty, in conduct, in habits and in learning.

sa: तस्मिन्निर्मानुषेऽरण्ये कुर्वाणस्तप उत्तमम्। अहमाक्रमितुं सौम्य तदारण्यमुपागमम्॥ तस्य रूपमरण्यस्य निर्देष्टुं न शशाक ह। फलमूलैः सुखास्वादैर्बहुरूपैश्च काननैः॥
en: In that forest of without men I used to perform my austere penances. Once on a time I began to roam all over the forest being willing to see well every nook and corner of it. And I saw that it was impossible to ascertain how very pleasant that forest was. In every place there were trees with profuse sweet fruits. and roots.

sa: प्रीतस्तस्मै नरपतिरप्रमेयपराक्रमः। ततश्चकारावभृथं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: The king of immeasurable kindness was thus much pleased and he concluded the sacrifice according to the rites of the ordinance.

sa: गजकच्छपतां प्राप्तावार्थं मूढचेतसौ। रोषदोषानुषङ्गेन तिर्यग्योनिगतावुभौ॥
en: Both fools now live as a tortoise and an elephant. Owing to their wrathful nature they have both become inferior animals.

sa: कच्चिच्छूराः कृतप्रज्ञाः पञ्च पञ्च स्वनुष्ठिताः। क्षेमं कुर्वन्ति संहत्य राजञ्जनपदे तव॥
en: O king, do the five wise and brave men employed in the five chief ports, (namely that of protecting the city, fort, the merchant and the agriculturists and of punishing the criminals) always do good to your kingdom by working in unison?

sa: संकीर्णचारधर्मेषु प्रतिलोमचरेषु च। पिशिताशिषु चान्त्येषु मूढ राजा भविष्यसि॥ गुरुदारप्रसक्तेषु तिर्यग्योनिगतेषु च। पशुधर्मेषु पापेषु म्लेच्छेषु त्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: You shall be the foolish king of those whose practise and precepts will be impure, whose women of superior birth will give birth to children by men of inferior birth, who will live on meat, who will be mean, who will not hesitate to appropriate the wives of their superiors, who will be like birds and beasts in their practise and who will be sinful and Mlecchas.

sa: गत्वोभय कर्मणा युज्यतेऽस्थिरं शुभस्य पापस्य स चापि कर्मणा। धर्मेण पापं प्रणुदतीह विद्वान् धर्मो बलीयानिति तस्य सिद्धिः॥
en: Having acquired both (i.e. the fruits of virtue and vice) which have an end (men of action attains heaven or hell for a limited time only), men of action again come into this world and become attached to actions by reasons of their previous virtue of vice. A wise man neutralizes the effects of his sinful acts by his virtues. Virtue is strong and hence his emancipation.

sa: कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो देवकीनन्दनाव्यया॥ वासुदेव जगन्नाथ प्रणतातिविनाशन। विश्वात्मन् विश्वजनक विश्वहर्तः प्रभोऽव्यय॥ प्रपन्नपाल गोपाल प्रजापाल परात्पर। आकृतीनां च चित्तीनां प्रवर्तक नतास्मि ते॥
en: (She said) O Krishna, O Krishna of mighty arms, O eternal, O son of Devaki.O Vasudeva, O lord of the universe, O you the killer of the difficulties of those that bow to you, O soul of the universe, O creator of the universe, O destroyer, O lord O inexhaustible. Oh the protector of the afflicted, O the saviour of kine and subjects, O the highest of the high, O the source of the mental perceptions such as faculties of knowledge and moral sense, I bow to you.

sa: रत्नैश्च बहुभिस्तत्र धर्मराजमवर्धयत् कथं तु मम कौरव्यो रत्नदानैः समाप्नुयात्॥ यज्ञमित्येव राजनः स्पर्धमाना ददुर्धनम्। भवनैः सविमानाप्रैः सोदर्बलसंवृतैः॥ लोकराजविमानैश्च ब्राह्मणावसथैः सह। कृतैरावसथैर्दिव्यैर्विमानप्रमिमैस्तथा।॥ विचित्रै रत्नवद्भिश्च ऋद्ध्या परमया युतैः। राजभिश्च समावृत्तैरतीव श्रीसमृद्धिभिः। अशोभत सदो राजन् कौन्तेयस्य महात्मनः॥
en: All (the assembled kings) honoured Dharmaraja with large presents of jewels, Every one of those kings proudly said, “Let the Kuru king complete his sacrifice with the gems and wealth that I present to him,(without taking any presents from any other king)”. O king, the sacrificial ground of the illustrious son of Kunti, crowded with guards and warriors, with the cars of the celestialss and with the kings, all possessing beauty and wealth, looked extremely handsome with the numerous palaces, so built as to last for ever, and so high that their tops touched the car of the celestialss who came to see that sacrifice, with the dwellings of the Brahmanas, and the mansions that were built for the king which resembled the cars of the celestialss, and adorned with gems and filled with every king of

sa: नारद उवाच गृहज्ञानी बहिःशास्त्रं पठतां विस्वरं पदम्। गरीयसोऽवजानातु यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Narada said Let him who has stolen your stalks be one who identifies the body with the soul! Let him study the scriptures with an unworthy preceptor. Let him chaunt the Vedas, violating at each step the rules of orthoepy! Let him disregard all his elders.

sa: द्वादश्यां पौर्णमास्यां च मासि मासि घृताक्षतम्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छेत तस्य पुण्यं निबोधत॥
en: On the twelfth lunar day, as also on the day of the full moon, every month, one should make gifts to Brahmanas of clarified butter and of Akshata. Listen to me as I say what the measure is of the merit that such a person wins.

sa: अथ पुरुषवौर कृताह्निको भवमभिपूज्य यथाविधि प्रभूम्। अरिवधकृतनिश्चयौ दुतं तव बलमर्जुनकेशवौ सृतौ॥
en: Thereupon those two best of all persons, Arjuna and Keshava, who were resolved upon slaughtering all their antagonists, after having finished the worship of lord Bhava, according to the ordained rites and also having performed their daily prayer ceremonies, with great rapidity proceeded against your force.

sa: न तु विक्रमकालोऽयं शान्तिकालोऽयमागतः। कालः स्थापयते सर्वं काल: पचति वै तथा॥
en: This, however, is not the time for displaying my prowess. On the other hand, the time that has come when I should conduct myself with peace and tranquillity. It is Time which establishes all things. Time acts upon all things and brings about their final consummation.

sa: तां योनिमावयोर्विद्धि योऽसौ सदसदात्मकः। आवाभ्यां पूज्यतेऽसौ हि दैवे पित्र्ये च कल्प्यते॥
en: Know that from her we two have originated. That all-pervading Soul, which is made of all existent and non-existent things, is worshipped by us. Even He is what we adore in all those rites that we perform in honour of the gods and the departed manes.

sa: ययातिरुवाच अहं ययातिनहुषस्य पुत्रः पूरोः पिता सर्वभूतावमानात्। प्रभ्रंशितः सुरसिद्धर्षिलोकात् परिच्युतः प्रपताम्यल्पपुण्यः॥
en: Yayati said : I am Yayati, the son of Nahusha and the father of Puru. I am falling down from the region of the celestials, the Siddhas and the Rishis, for the diminution of my virtues. (I am falling), because I disregarded every creature on earth.

sa: शक्रविष्णू हि संग्रामे चेरतुस्तारकामये। रथेन तेन वै कृष्ण उपारुह्य ययौ तदा॥
en: It was in this very car that Indra and Vishnu fought in the battle of old (with the Asuras) in which Taraka (the wife of Brihaspati) was cause, and the result of which was a great slaughter. Riding on that very car, Krishna now came out.

sa: तथा धर्मपरे क्षत्रे सहस्राक्ष: शतक्रतुः। स्वादु देशे च काले च वर्षेणापालयत्प्रजाः॥
en: And (Indra) the deity that performed one hundred sacrifices and who has one thousand eyes, seeing that all the Kshatriya sovereigns ruled their kingdoms very virtuously, poured down vivifying showers of rains at the proper time and at the proper place and thus protected all creatures.

sa: ततो विभक्तास्त्वन्योऽन्य विक्रुध्यन्तेऽर्थमोहिताः। ततः स्वार्थपरान्मूढान्पृथग्भूतान्स्वकैर्धनैः॥ विदित्वा भेदयन्त्येतानमित्रामित्ररूपिणः। विदित्वा चापरे भिन्नानन्तरेषु पतन्त्यथ॥
en: But as soon as it is partitioned, they begin to quarrel from the blindness arising from wealth. And enemies in the guise of friends, cause estrangement between ignorant and selfish brothers. They confirm their quarrels by pointing out faults and thus they fall one by one.

sa: निवेशने॥ स चेन्ममार सृञ्जय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया॥ पुत्रात् पुण्यतरस्तुभ्यं मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः। अयज्वानमदाक्षिण्यमभि श्वत्येत्युदाहरत्॥
en: When even such a king, O Srinjaya, died, who was superior to you in respect of the four cardinal virtues and consequently far superior to your son, you should not lament for your son saying-'O Shvaitya’, who did perform no sacrifice and make no sacrificial presents.

sa: नदी भविष्यसि शुभे कुटिला वार्षिकोदका। दुस्तीर्था न तु विज्ञेया वार्षिकी नाष्टमासिकी॥
en: You shall be turned to a tortuous river, O fair one, with water (only in the rains. Your water shall be inaccessible and unknown, and (as you shall be) with water only during the rainy season, you shall be dry for eight months (in the year);

sa: चतुर्णां मध्यमौ श्रेष्ठौ नित्यं शङ्कयौ तथापरौ। सर्वे नित्यं शङ्कितव्याः प्रत्यक्षं कार्यमात्मनः॥
en: Of the four kinds of friends, the second and the third are superior, while the first and the fourth should always be looked upon with suspicion. Regarding those acts, however, which the king should do personally, he should always look with suspicion on all the four.

sa: असम्बाधा हि सा पार्थ रम्या कामगमा सभा। दीर्घकालं तपस्तत्वा निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा॥
en: O son of Pritha, they are so numerous that unable to describe them, either mentioning them by their names or deeds. The Sabha is capable of going everywhere at will, it is wide of extent; it is beautiful. Vishvakarma has built it after long continued asceticism.

sa: सुसंहताः सुतनवो व्यूढोरस्काः सुसंस्थिताः। प्रवादितेषु कुप्यन्ति हृष्यन्ति कलहेषु च॥ गम्भीराक्षा निःसृताक्षाः पिङ्गाक्षा भृकुटीमुखाः। नकुलाक्षास्तथा चैव सर्वे शूरास्तनुत्यजः॥
en: Those, who have well-formed, and symmetrical and beautiful bodies, and broad chests, who are irate upon hearing the enemy's drum or trumpet, who take delight in fights of every kind, who have eyes indicative of gravity, or eyes which seem to shoot out, or eyes which are green, those who have frowning faces, or eyes like those of the mongoose, are all brave and capable of sacrificing their lives in battle.

sa: पुत्रा निवेश्याश्च कुलाद् भृत्या लभ्याश्च भारत। शिरःस्नातोऽथ कुर्वीत दैवं पित्र्यमथापि च॥
en: Sons should also be settled and a portion of the family inheritance given to them, O Bharata, as their provision. One should bathe by dipping his head in water before he sits down to perform any act in honour of the departed Manes or the deities.

sa: अर्थानां च पुनद्वैध नित्यं भवति संशयः। अन्यथा चिन्तितो ह्यर्थः पुनर्भवति सोऽन्यथा।॥
en: Doubt always exists in one of the alternatives of an object; an object, thought of in one way, becomes another (in the end). Even persons, conversant with morality, are confounded in their own acts; (we have come) to fight with the Matsya's stationed in the north.

sa: न चासीतासने भिन्ने भिन्नकांस्यं च वर्जयेत्॥ नैकवस्त्रेण भोक्तव्यं न नग्नः स्नातुमर्हति।
en: One should never sit on a torn or broken seat. One should, without using it any longer, throw away a broken vessel of white brass. One should, never eat without a piece of upper garinent covering his body. One should never bathe in a nude state.

sa: जानासि हि यथा सौम्य न मातृषु ममान्तरम्। भूतपूर्वं विशेषो वा तस्या मयि सुतेऽपि वा॥ सोऽभिषेकनिवृत्त्यथैः प्रवासाथैश्च दुर्वचैः। उग्रैर्वाक्यैरहं तस्या नान्यद् दैवात् समर्थये॥
en: Do you know, Oh gentle Laksmana, that I have never made any distinction in my mind between my mothers, nor did Kaikeyi make any such thing before between me and her son; consequently it is destiny only that has made her press for the prevention of my installation and for my exile with harsh and cruel words, or else why should she, a daughter of a king and possessed of an excellent temper and high accomplishments, speak painful words to me in the presence of her husband like to an ordinary woman.

sa: बलं बुद्धिश्च तेजश्च सत्त्वं च हरिपुङ्गव। विशिष्टं सर्वभूतेषु किमात्मानं न सज्जसे।७।।
en: Your energy and prowess are not surpassed by him And your strength, and your understanding, your energy, and your vigour, O foremost of monkeys, (is known among all creatures). Why did not you prepare yourself furnished with everything that is noble or great, (for this feat)?

sa: तन्मया वार्यमाणस्तु यदि रामेण विग्रहम्। करिष्यस्यापदं घोरां क्षिप्रं प्राप्य न शिष्यसि॥
en: It is for this that I do prevent you; you shall be overwhelmed with calamities and meet with destruction if do you engage yourself in battle with him. In vain shall you bring about the affliction of the mirthful and sportive Rākşasas ever witnessing social festivities.

sa: अद्य रामाभिषेको वै प्रसिद्ध इति जज्ञिवान् ॥ प्रियाहाँ प्रियमाख्यातुं विवेशान्तःपुरं वशी।
en: "To-day it has been fixed to install Rāma, but Kaikeyi has not yet heard of it”, thus thought the monarch. Therefore with the view of communicating the welcome news to that lady deserving of good, (Kaikeyi), that renowned one of subdued senses entered the inner apartment.

sa: कङ्कबर्हिणवासोभिर्बलं व्यधमदर्जुनः। तद् बलं भरतश्रेष्ठ सवाजिद्विपमानवम्॥ पाकशासनिरायत्तः पार्थः स निजघान ह॥
en: Furnished with wings made of the feathers of the peacock and the Kanka, Arjuna began to agitate that army of yours. O foremost of the Bharatas, Partha, the son of Pakasasani (Indra) then began to carnage that host of yours, consisting of horses elephants and men.

sa: महारथः कृतिमान् क्षिप्रहस्तो दृढायुधो दृढमुष्टिढेषुः। स वीर्यमान् द्रोणपुत्रस्तरस्वी व्यवस्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे ॥
en: That great car-warrior, the high-souled son of Drona's-who is most expert in military performances, light-handed, having steng weapons and the strongest fist among the boxers and capable of shooting surely from a distance, is still staying in the field most desirous of fighting for your sake.

sa: तेषां द्विपानां निचकर्त पार्थो वर्माणि चर्माणि करान् नियन्तृन्। र्वजाहतानीव गिरेः शिरांसि॥
en: The son of Pritha severed into fragments, the armour, the vital parts, the trunks, the riders, the standards and flags of those elephants, which then fell down upon the earth, even as the summits of mountains drop down on the ground, when smitten by the thunder.

sa: व्रात्याः संक्लिष्टकर्माणः प्रकृत्यैव च गर्हिताः। वृष्ण्यन्धकाः कथं पार्थ प्रमाणं भवता कृताः॥
en: The Vrishnis and the Andhakas are vile Kshatriyas, ever engaged in perpetrating low deeds and are by nature wedded to shameful conduct. Why, O Partha, have you chosen them to be your model?” Being thus spoken to Partha then replied to Bhurisravas sayingएवमुक्तो रणे पार्थो भूरिश्रवसमब्रवीत्।

sa: देवोद्यानानि सर्वाणि प्रियाणि च दिवोकसाम्। ऋषीणामाश्रमान् पुण्यान् रभ्याजनपदांस्तथा॥ व्यनाशयन्नमर्यादा दानवा दुष्टचारिणः।
en: All over the celestials, forests and different other regions that had been very dear to celestials themselves and the scared asylums belonging to the sages, as also the most excellent abodes of men. Moreover these Danavas, who behaved most cruelly, had damaged the honour of all.

sa: नाप्याददत् संदधन्नैव मुञ्चन् वाणान् रथेऽद्दश्यत सव्यसाची। रथांश्च नागांस्तुरगान् पदातीन् संस्यूतदेहान् दद्दशुर्हतांश्च॥
en: Savyasachin could not be seen while taking up the arrows, or aiming them, or shooting them. But only this could be seen that the elephants, the horses, the foot-soldiers and the cars (i.e. the car-warriors), with their bodies cut-off, were slain (with the arrows of Arjuna).

sa: शरार्चिष गाण्डिवचारुमण्डलं युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमानतेजसम्। न कौरवाः शेकुरुदीक्षितुं जयं यथा रविं व्याधितचक्षुषो जनाः॥
en: As persons with sore eyes cannot look up towards the sun so Jaya (Arjuna) whose arrows were brilliant like the rays of the all-burning sun at the end of Yuga and whose bow Gandiva formed his circular disk, could not be looked at by the Kauravas.

sa: एकं रथं सम्परिवार्य मृत्यु नयन्त्यनेके च रथाः समेताः। स्तथा रथश्चापि रथाननेकान्॥
en: Many car-warriors, assembled together, assailing an opponent dispatched him off to the King of Terrors; while a supreme car-warrior, fighting the good fight with a single adversary, hastened his departure to the other world or another, assailing many in close contest, launched them all into eternity.

sa: संजय उवाच अथोपयातौ पृथुलोहिताक्षौ शरचिताङ्गौ रुधिरप्रदिग्धौ। समीक्ष्य सेनाग्रनरप्रवीरौ युधिष्ठिरो वाक्यमिदं बभाषे॥
en: Sanjaya said Sri Krishna and Arjuna, the fore-front fighter in battle, the eminent warrior, having huge and red eyes when approached closer, the arrows stuck in their all organs of body were seen. They soaked in blood. Yudhishthira, on seeing them, started talking in following manner-

sa: गृहीतवाक्यो नयविद् वदान्यः शेषानभोक्ता ह्यविहिंसकश्च। नानर्थकृत्याकुलितः कृतज्ञः सत्यो मृदुः स्वर्गमुपैति विद्वान्॥
en: The wise man, who is skillful in speech, knows the code of morality. He eats last (i.e. after having made due offerings to the gods and Pitris). He is not envious; he does not injure others; he is skillful, grateful, truthful and humble. He attains heaven.

sa: संक्लिष्टकर्माणतिप्रमादं नित्यानृतं चादृढभक्तिकं च। विसृष्टरागं पटुमानिनं चाप्येतान् न सेवेत नराधमान् षट्॥
en: One who always acts against his interests, one who always makes blunders, one who always speaks falsehood, one not firm in his devotion, one wanting in affection and one who thinks himself able to perform all tasksthese six worst classes of men should never be served.

sa: स सूदरूपः परमेण वर्चसा रविर्यथा लोकमिमं प्रकाशयन्। स्तं मत्स्यराजं समुपेत्य तस्थिवान्॥
en: Although in the guise of a cook he endued with the strength of the lord of mountains, and attired in dark garments, reached the king of the Matsya's and stood before him illuming, with his great splendour, all around him like the sun revealing the world.

sa: को हनन्तरमात्मानं ब्राह्मणो हन्तुमर्हति। निर्लिङ्गमचलं शुद्धं सर्वद्वैतविवर्जितम्॥ तस्माद्धि क्षत्रियस्यापि ब्रह्मावसति पश्यति॥
en: What other Brahmana is worthy to know the supreme soul, that has no form, is without change, is alone and is devoid of all sorts of duality. By the performance of such practices, the supreme soul resides in a Kshatriya too and is seen by him.

sa: बद्धः पाशैश्च्युतः स्थानाद् द्विषतां वशमागतः। श्रिया विहीनः प्रह्लाद शोचितव्ये न शोचसि॥
en: You are now bound in fetters, fallen off from your former position, brought under the sway of your foes, and divested of prosperity. Your present circumstances are such as may well give room to grief. Yet how is it, O Prahlada, that you do not grieve.

sa: विरिक्तस्य यथा सम्यग् घृतं भवति भेषजम्। तथा निर्हतदोषस्य प्रेत्य धर्मः सुखावहः॥
en: A person, after clearing his bowels, should lake clarified butter, butter, which acts most beneficially on his system. Likewise, when one has freed himself of all faults and busies himself with the acquisition of virtue, that Virtue in the next world, brings on the highest happiness.

sa: यश्च राजा महोत्साहः क्षत्रधर्मे रतो भवेत्। स तुष्येद् दशभागेन ततस्त्वन्यो दशावरैः॥
en: That king who is gifted with great energy and who is firmly attached to Kshatriya duties, should be satisfied with only a tenth part of the produce of the subject's field.Other kings are seen to be satisfied with less than a tenth part of such produce.

sa: एतद् बुद्ध्वा भवेद् बुद्धः किमन्यद् बुद्धलक्षणम्। विज्ञाय तद्धि मन्यन्ते कृतकृत्या मनीषिणः॥
en: That which strikes the Ignorant with fear can never create fear in persons of Knowledge. There is no higher and for anybody than Liberation. The sages say that on account of the excess or otherwise of good qualities, differences are seen regarding the degree of Liberation.

sa: ब्रह्मा भवश्च विष्णुश्च स्कन्देन्द्रौ सविता यमः। वरुणेन्दू मनुर्धाता विधाता त्वं धनेश्वरः॥
en: You are the Grandfather Brahman, you are Bhava, you are Vishnu, you are Skanda, you are Indra, you are Savitri, you are Yama you are Varuna, you are Soma, you are Dhatri, you are Manu, you are Vidhatri, and you are Kubera the Lord of riches.

sa: महावराहसृष्टा च पिण्डोत्पत्तिः पुरातनी। प्रवृत्तौ च निवृत्तौ च यो यथा परिकल्पितः॥
en: I have also heard from you the origin of the Pinda (funeral cake), from the mighty Boar. I have heard from you about those gods and Rishis that were ordained for the religion of Action and of those that were ordained for the Religion of Renunciation.

sa: महर्षयस्तुष्टुवुरजसा च तं वृषाकपि सर्वचराचरेश्वरम्। हिमापहो हव्यमुवाह चाध्वरे तथामृतं चार्पितमीश्वरोऽपि हि॥
en: The great Rishis lauded that lord of all mobile and immobile creatures. The Fire-God Once more began to carry the libations of clarified butter that were poured into his visible form, and the great god took charge of the nectar that was placed to his care.

sa: अनुयोक्ता च यो विप्रो अनुयुक्तश्च भारत। नाहतस्तावपि श्राद्धं ब्रह्मविक्रयिणौ हि तौ॥
en: That Brahmana who is paid for his services as a preceptor or who attends as a pupil upon the lectures of some preceptor for an allowance paid to him, does not deserve to be invited, for both of thein are considered as sellers of Vedic learning.

sa: त्रिदण्डादिषु यद्यस्ति मोक्षो ज्ञानेन कस्यचित्। छत्रादिषु कथं न स्यात् तुल्यहेतौ परिग्रहे॥
en: If one can acquire Liberation by means of knowledge, then may Liberation exist in triple sticks. Why then may Liberation not exist in the umbrella and the sceptre as well, especially when the reason in taking up the triple stick and the scepture is the same.

sa: अलाभे यो गवां दद्याद् घृतधेनुं यतव्रतः। तस्यैता घृतवाहिन्यः क्षरन्ते वत्सला इव॥
en: If in the absence of kine, one makes a gift of a cow made of clarified butter, observant of a vow the while, one gets for one's use these rivers of clarified butter all of which approach one like an affectionate mother approaching her loved child.

sa: छत्रप्रदानेन गृहं वरिष्ठं यानं तथोपानहसम्प्रदाने। वस्त्रप्रदानेन फलं स्वरूपं गन्धप्रदानात् सुरभिर्नरः स्यात्॥
en: By making gift of an umbrella, one acquires a palatial residence. By making gift of a pair of sandals or shoes, one acquires good cars, The reward of cloths, is personal beauty, and by making gifts of scents, one gets a fragrant body in next life.

sa: तेषु शुद्धेषु दान्तेषु स्वदारपरितोषिषु। यत् करिष्यसि कल्याणं तत् ते लोके युधाम्पते॥
en: Whatever gifts you may make to those persons of pure conduct, of thorough mastery over their senses, and always contented with their own married wives, are sure to acquire for you a merit that will accompany you in all the worlds into which you may go.

sa: आगतानागते चोभे ब्राह्मणो द्विपदां वरः। ब्राह्मणो भरतश्रेष्ठ स्वधर्मं चैव वेद यः॥
en: The Brahmana is conversant with that which has taken place and that which will take place. The Brahmana is the foremost of all twolegged beings. The Brahmana, O chief of the Bharatas, is fully conversant with those duties which have been laid down for his order.

sa: पयस्विनीनामथ रोहिणीनां तथैवान्याननडुहो लोकनाथ। प्रादां नित्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सुरेश नेहागतस्तेन फलेन चाहम्॥
en: Indeed, O Lord of the universe, every one of those kine belonged to the Rohini species and gave milk at the time I gave them away. It is not through the merits of those deeds, O king of the deities, that I have acquired this region.

sa: ये वेदं प्राप्य दुर्धर्षा वाग्मिनो ब्रह्मचारिणः। याजनाध्यापने युक्ता नित्यं तान् पूजयाम्यहम्॥
en: I worship them who have become irresistible by studying the Vedas, who are eloquent in discoursing on the scriptures, who are observant of the vow of Brahmacharya, and who are always devoted to the duties of officiating at the sacrifices of others and of teaching disciples.

sa: शान्तिकं पौष्टिकं रक्षा शत्रुभं भयनाशनम्। जप्यं यद् ब्रह्मसमितं तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: You should tell me what, indeed, what Mantra it is, which propitiates all malevolent influences, or brings on prosperity or growth or protection from evil, or the destruction of enemies, or the dispelling of fears, and which, at the same time, is consistent with the Vedas.

sa: मम नाम त्वया वीर गतस्य यमसादनम्। प्रेतकार्याणि कार्याणि विपरीते हि वर्तसे॥
en: O hero, I having gone to the region of Yama, you ought to have performed my last rites, but you stand in a relation the very reverse of this.* *i.e. I have to perform your last rites, you having fallen in fight while I am alive.

sa: सोऽब्रवीद्रावणो भूयस्तां कन्यां सुमहाव्रताम्। अवरुह्य विमानाग्रात्कंदर्पशरपीडितः॥
en: Thereat descending from the front of his car, Ravana, affected with the shafts of Kandarpa, again addressed that girl, observant of a mighty VOW. a

sa: रक्षितं सुमहावीर्यातुधानैः सहस्रशः। राक्षसाधिपतेर्गुप्तमाविवेश गृहं कपिः॥
en: The monkey entered the palace protected by the Rākṣasa chief, guarded by maddened beasts and birds, and thousands of gobbling endowed with exceeding great prowess.

sa: समीपं राजसिंहस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः। संकल्पहयसंयुक्तैर्यान्तीमिव मनोरथैः॥
en: She was proceeding as it were to that lion of a king-Rāma, knowing his own-self, in her mind's chariot drawn by the horses of resolution.

sa: व्यक्तमेष महायोगी परमात्मा सनातनः॥ अनादिमध्यनिधनो महतः परमो महान्। तमसः परमो धाता शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः॥ श्रीवत्सवक्षा नित्यश्रीरजय्यः शाश्वतो ध्रुवः। मानुषं रूपमास्थाय विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ सर्वैः परिवृत्तो देवैर्वानरत्वमुपागतः। सर्वलोकेश्वरः श्रीमॅल्लोकानां हितकाम्यया।॥ स राक्षसपरीवारं देवशत्रु भयावहम्।
en: It is evident that the great ascetic Vişnu having truth for his prowess-the soul of all beings ever existing, without beginning, middle or end, greater than the great, the Preserver of the Nature, holding conch discus and club having Śrīvatsa* on his breast, always beautiful, incapable of being conquered, without destruction, devoid of end, and the lord of all men, assuming this shape of a man and encircled by the celestials, assuming monkey shapes, has for the behoof of mankind, slain (you) the dreadful enemy of the gods with all (your) family and Rākşasas. *A particular mark usually said to be a curl of hair on the breast of Vişnu. The emblem of the tenth jina or the mark above ascribed to Vişņu or Kṛṣṇa.

sa: स तं समासाद्य हरि हरीक्षणो युगान्तकालाग्निमिव प्रजाक्षये। अवस्थितं विस्मिजातसम्भ्रमं समैक्षताक्षो बहुमानचक्षुषा ॥
en: Coming before the monkey, Akşa, having the gaze of a lion, with eyes betokening regard, gazed at Hanumān resembling the Fire on the occasion of the universal dissolution at the end of a Yuga, intent on destroying creatures, and who was seated and was influenced alike by surprise and regard.

sa: अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। अधस्ताच्छिशपामूले साध्वी करुणमास्थिता॥
en: (And I beheld there) in the Asoka forest of the vicious-souled Rāvana, at the foot of a ſingśapā tree, the chaste Sītā waiting very poorly.

sa: स राजदृष्टिसंपन्नमासनं हेमभूषितम्। जगाम समुदाचारं प्रयुज्याचारकोविदः॥
en: That one acquainted with manners, after proper courtesy, sat him down on a seat decked in gold, which was pointed out (by a royal glance).

sa: नर्चिष्मतः कालनिकाशरूपान्। सहेत बाणान्यमदण्डकल्पान् समक्षमुक्तान्युधि राघवेण॥
en: Who shall withstand in battle, the shafts, shot by Raghava, resembling the rod of Death, the stick of Brahmā, flaming like the Fire of Dissolution.

sa: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां गन्धर्वोरंगपक्षिणाम्। राजपुत्र दशग्रीवो वरदानात्स्वयंभुवः॥
en: O prince, by virtue of the bocn acquired from the Self-Create, the Ten-necked one is incapable of being slain by all creatures-Gandharvas, serpents, or birds.

sa: लोकक्षयकर भीमं भयं पश्याम्युपस्थितम्। प्रबर्हणं प्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम्॥
en: Mighty is the fear that I see at hand, boding destruction to people and the slaughter of the foremost heroes of bears, monkeys and Rākşasas.

sa: सागरे पतिताः केचित्केचिद्गगनमाश्रिताः। ऋक्षा वृक्षानुपारूढा वानरैयमितिश्रिताः॥
en: Some have fallen into the sea, and some have taken refuge in the sky; and the bears have mounted up trees along with the monkeys.

sa: हनूमान्पश्चिमद्वारं निष्पीड्य पवनात्मजः। प्रविशत्वप्रमेयात्मा बहुभिः कपिभिर्वृतः॥
en: And let that son of the Wind-god, Hanuman, backed by innumerable monkeys, (beating the host stationed) at the Western gate, find entrance (into the city).

sa: महाञ्छब्दोऽभवत्तत्र बलौघस्याभिवर्ततः। सागरस्येव भित्रस्य यथा स्यात्सलिलस्वनः॥
en: Like to the roar of water on the ocean being riven, there arose a mighty tumult in consequence of the forces surging hither and thither.

sa: तुरंगखुरविध्वस्तं रथनेमिसमुत्थितम्॥ रुरोध कर्णनेत्राणि युध्यतां धरणीरजः।
en: The dust of the earth arising from warring combatants, and from the hoofs of horses and the wheels of cars, choked up eye and ear.

sa: कबन्धानि समुत्पेतुर्भीरूणां भीषणानि वै। भुजपाणिशिरश्छिन्नाश्छिन्नकायाश्च भूतले॥
en: Striking affright to the timid, on the earth started up (spectral) headless trunks, with their arms and heads torn, ant their bodies riven all over.

sa: तया भिन्नतनुत्राणः प्राविशद्विपुलं तमः। माल्यवान्पुनराश्वस्तस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: On having his mail rent, Mālyāvan was utterly deprived of his senses; but (anon) reposing for a while, he again stood like a moveless hill.

sa: स चाप्रतिमगाम्भीर्यो देवदानवदर्पहा॥ ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतस्तु कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम्।
en: Do you wake up that destroyer of the pride of the deities and then Danavas-Kumbhakarma, endowed with unparalleled gravity, overwhelmed with the curse of Brahmā.

sa: सर्वमेवाभिषेकार्थं जयाहस्य महात्मनः। कर्तुमर्हथ रामस्य यद्यन्मङ्गलपूर्वकम्॥
en: (Thereupon they ordered the servants) saying, Do you collect materials necessary for the auspicious installation of the high-souled (Rama) worthy of being crowned with victory.

sa: संदर्शयामास तदा रावणिं रघुनन्दनः। असंभ्रान्तो महातेजास्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then that exceedingly energetic one, Rahgu's son, possessing himself in calmness, displayed (his prowess) to the son of Ravana; and this was wonderful (to behold).

sa: एवमेतद् विचेतव्यं भवद्भिर्वानरोत्तमैः। तदुग्रशासनं भर्तुर्विज्ञाय हरिपुङ्गवाः॥
en: The monkey-chiefs, knowing the stern command of their lord should search in all these places. Then, covering up the earth like locusts, they marched away.

sa: ततो नारायणो विष्णुर्नियुक्तः सुरसत्तमैः। जानन्नपि सुरानेवं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रवीत्॥ उपायः को वधे तस्य राक्षसाधिपतेः सुराः। यमहं तं समास्थाय निहन्यामृषिकण्टकम्॥
en: Thus besought by the foremost of the celestials, that searcher of hearts, Visnu, although cognizant of the means whereby Rāvana was to be destroyed, asked the gods these amiable words,-What, you gods, is the means of compassing which I could slay that thorn of the ascetics? Nara means a multitude, and Ayana, dwellingplace. He whose dwelling-place is a multitude, is Nārāyana. Metaphorically, the word means evidently the Scorcher of hearts, worlds, and dreadful to ascetics!

sa: अत्यन्तसुखसंचारा मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतः सुखाः। दिवसाः सुभगादित्याश्छायासलिलदुर्भगाः॥
en: At midday the days are delightful to a degree to range in, feel highly agreeable, and have pleasant suns; while shade and water are uncomfortable.

sa: वर्णेष्वर्यचतुर्थेषु देवतातिथिपूजकाः। कृतज्ञाच वदान्याच शूरा विक्रमसंयुताः॥
en: The four orders with Brāhmanas at their head contained persons serving gods and guests, and endowed with gratitude, and munificent, and heroic, and possessing prowess.

sa: चञ्चच्चन्द्रकरस्पर्शहर्षोन्मीलिततारका। अहो रागवती संध्या जहाति स्वयमम्बरम्॥
en: The red-dyed evening has renounced the welkin, being delighted at the touch of the rays of the Moon and opening a little her eyes—the stars.

sa: ततो रामस्तु संक्रुद्धो मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकः॥ ससर्ज निशितान् बाणाञ्छतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। दुरावारान् दुर्विषहान् कालपाशोपमान् रणे॥
en: Then Rama getting enraged, bringing his bow to a circle, discharged sharpened shafts by hundreds and by thousands. And as if in sport, Rāma in the conflict shot irresistible (shafts) furnished with Kanka feathers, and decked with gold, irresistible, capable of inflicting extreme pain, and resembling the noose of Death.

sa: विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरप्रभम्। रथप्रवरमारूढमाकाशे विबुधानुगम्॥ असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्। सम्प्रभाभरणं देवं विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्॥
en: He saw the lord of the celestials, possessed of a resplendent person, resembling in effulgence the sun or Vaisvanara-mounted on a superb car (saw) him that is followed by all the celestials, stationed in the sky, not touching the earth, adorned in luminous ornaments-the god dressed in a clean appear!

sa: विप्रस्थितेषु देवेषु विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः॥ ऊर्ध्वबाहुनिरालम्बो वायुभक्षस्तपश्चरन्।
en: And when the celestials had gone, the mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra, with upraised arms, and without any support, and subsisting on air, began to perform penances.

sa: प्रविष्टस्तु वनं घोरं बहुपुष्पफलद्रुमम्। ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते चीरमालापरिष्कृतम्॥
en: And having entered the dense forest abounding in blossoms and fruits and trees, Rāma saw in a recess an asylum glittering with bark and garlands.

sa: तस्याश्चानृजुवृत्तायास्तयोश्च हतयोरहम्। सफेनं पातुमिच्छामि रुधिरं रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Nor I wish in the midst of encounter to drink the frothy blood of that crooked one as well as those two slain (in battle).

sa: राममिन्दीवरश्यामं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम्। पश्यामो यौवराज्यस्थं तव राजोत्तमात्मजम्॥
en: And we would behold the son of the foremost of monarchs, the foe-destroying. Rāma dark-blue like a lotus, installed as the heir-apparent to the kingdom.

sa: तमेवंगुणसम्पन्नं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। लोकपालोपमं नाथमकामयत मेदिनी॥
en: And even that Rāma, crowned with such qualities and having truth for his prowess, like a Lokapāla, the Earth wishes to have for her lord.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं भरतः कौसल्यासुतमब्रवीत्। तेजसाऽऽदित्यसंकाशं प्रतिपच्चन्द्रदर्शनम्॥
en: When Rāma resembling the sun in energy and like the moon of Pratipat in appearance, had said this, Bharata said to the son of Kausalya.

sa: मद्भयार्तः परित्यज्य स्वमधिष्ठानमृद्धिमत्। कैलासं पर्वतश्रेष्ठमध्यास्ते नरवाहनः॥
en: Thereat, that one carried by men, renouncing out of my fear this wealthy abode of Lankā, has been living on that Lord of mountains, Kailāśa.

sa: तमतिक्रम्य चाकाशं सर्वतः शतयोजनम्। अपर्वतनदीवृक्षं सर्वसत्त्वविवर्जितम्॥
en: Going beyond it, (you come upon) a vacant land, measuring an hundred Yojanas, without mountains, or rivers, or trees; and void of all living beings.

sa: गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषः सोत्कृष्टहसितस्वरैः। श्रूयते सततं तत्र सर्वभूतमनोरमः॥
en: And there are continually heard there the sounds of instruments and the voice of song mixed with sweet hilarious laughter, capable of taking all crcatures.

sa: अविदूरादयं नद्या बहुपुष्पप्रवालवान्। सुमहानिङ्गुदीवृक्षो वसामोऽत्रैव सारथे॥
en: There is hard by the river a gigantic Ingudī tree, bearing a profusion of flowers and fresh leaves. Here, O charioteer, will we stay to-day.

sa: स बाष्पपूर्णवदनो निःश्वसशोकमूर्च्छितः। मामुवाच महातेजाः कृताञ्जलिमुपस्थितम्॥
en: With eyes flooded with tears, and well nigh deprived of his senses by grief, that highly energetic one said to me standing with joined hands.

sa: द्विजैरभिविनीतश्च श्रेष्ठैर्धर्मार्थनैपुणैः। यदा व्रजति संग्रामं ग्रामार्थे नगरस्य वा॥ गत्वा सौमित्रिसहितो नाविजित्य निवर्तते।
en: He is lowly to those twice bom ones that are worthy and are conversant with morality and interest. And when in company with Sumitra's son he wended to the fight with the view of protecting a city or a province, he came not back without conquering the foe. on or

sa: निशाकरस्य राजर्षेः प्रसादादमितौजसः॥ आदित्यरश्मिनिर्दग्धौ पक्षौ पुनरुपस्थितौ।
en: By the grace of that Rājarși of immeasurable energy, my wings, which had been burnt up by the rays of the sun, have grown again.

sa: तावेकरथमारूढौ भ्रातरौ वृषकाचलौ। शरवर्षेण बीभत्सुमविध्येतां मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Then those two heroic brothers Vrishaka and Achala, both riding on the self same car, began incessantly to pierce Pritha's son with their arrowy downpour.

sa: ततोऽभिमन्युः संक्रुद्धस्त्रास्यमानस्तवात्मजैः। विदर्शयन् वै सुमहच्छिक्षौरसकृतं बलम्॥
en: Then Abhimanyu, enraged in consequence of your sons seeking to terrify him displayed his marvelous might that he had acquired through his culture and practices.

sa: मानसाश्च महाराज वैश्यधर्मोपजीविनः॥ सर्वकामसमायुक्ताः शूरा धर्मार्थनिश्चिताः।
en: O king, the Manasas follow the duties of the Vaishyas. Having all their desires gratified, they are brave and firmly devoted to Dharma and Artha.

sa: तेष्वनीकेषु सर्वेषु स्थितेष्वाहवनन्दिषु। भरद्वाजो महाराज जयद्रथमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: When those divisions that ever delighted in fight, were disposed of in order, O mighty monarch, the son of Bharadvaja addressing Jayadratha said these words.

sa: राज्ञस्त्वनन्तरो राजा पाञ्चाल्यो दुपदोऽभवत्। जातरूपमयच्छत्रः सर्वैस्तैरभिरक्षितः॥
en: After king Yudhishthira, came Drupada, the ruler of the Panchalas, with a golden umbrella held over his head and himself protected by all those soldiers.

sa: ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगा:। पिशाचा मानुशाश्चैव मृगपक्षिसरीसृपाः॥
en: The sages, the celestials, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Pannagas, the Pishachas, and men, and the animals, and birds and men and reptiles.

sa: अमङ्गल्यध्वजश्चैव याज्ञसेनिर्महाबलः। न ग्रामङ्गलिके तस्मिन् प्रहरेदापगासुतः॥
en: This mighty son of Yajnasena is thus reckoned as an inauspicious sign. The son of the ocean-going Ganga will not therefore strike that inauspicious person.

sa: हतशेषैर्महाराज द्विसाहौर्हयोत्तमैः। निहन्तुकामः समरे इरावन्तं महाबलम्॥
en: He was desirous, O king, of slaying in battle the highly puissant Iravat, along with the two thousands excellent cavalry that survived the recent conflict.

sa: नराश्वकायैः पतितैर्दन्तिभिश्च महाहवे। अगम्यरूपा पृथिवी मांसशोणितकर्दमा॥
en: The ground becoming muddy with flesh and blood, became impassable with the bodies of men, horses and elephants, that were killed in that fearful battle.

sa: ततः शिलाशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मल्लैरानतपर्वभिः॥ छित्त्वा धनूंषि शूराणामार्जुनिः कर्णमादयत्।
en: Thereafter having cut-off the bows of warriors, with broad-headed shafts of depressed knots all whetted on stone, Arjuna's son began to afflict Karna in return.

sa: क्षत्रवर्मा सिन्धुपतेश्छित्त्वा केतनकार्मुके। नाराचैर्दशभिः क्रुद्धः सर्वमर्मस्वताडयत्॥
en: Kshatravarman cutting down the bow and banner of the ruler of the Sindhus and excited with wrath, pierced him in his vitals with ten Narachas.

sa: संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः। योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति॥
en: O mighty-armed, asceticism is difficult to be attained without the Yoga of action. The sage, possessed of Yoga of action attains to Brahma without delay.

sa: ततो दुःशासनस्त्रस्तः सहानीकः शरार्दितः। द्रोणं त्रातारमाकाक्षशकटव्यूहमभ्यगात्॥
en: Then Dushasana afraid and afflicted with shafts, with his whole division, feel back upon the Sakata array and looked upon Drona as his only protector.

sa: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः। गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्॥
en: When (this Self) the king of the body, assumes or quits the body, it departs taking them away, as the wind takes away the fragrance.

sa: पाष्णर्यंङ्गुष्टाङ्कुशे गं चादयन्तस्तथा परे। शरैः सम्मोहिताश्चान्ये तमेवाभिमुखा ययुः। तव योधा हतोत्साहा विभ्रान्तमनसस्तदा।॥
en: Others (riding on elephants) fled urging their huge by pressing their sides with toes or with the stroke of the hooks; others again confounded by Parthas arrows, even fled to the direction of Partha himself. Thus then all your warriors were deprived of sense and their minds also became distracted.

sa: निवीरितस्तु द्रोणेन धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। न्यवारयच्छरौघांस्तांश्चर्मणा कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: We then saw that the great car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna stood where he was. He warded off those showers of arrows using his arms with great dexterity.

sa: ततो दुःशासनश्चैव विकर्णश्च तवात्मजौ। सिन्धुराजार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमग्रानीके व्यवस्थितौ॥
en: Your other two sons, Dushasana and Vikarna, stationed themselves amidst the advance division of the army, for securing success to the king of the Sindhus.

sa: स काञ्चनविचित्रेण कवचेन समावृतः। जाम्बूनदशिरस्त्राणः शूरस्तीव्रपराक्रमः॥
en: That hero of fierce energy was cased in a coat of mail worked exquisitely with gold and he wore also a helmet of pure gold.

sa: बालादित्याम्बुजेन्दूनां तुल्यरूपाणि मारिष। संच्छिन्नान्यर्जुनशरैः शिरांस्युा प्रपेदिरे॥
en: Heads, O sire, resembling the rising sun or the lotus or the moon, being severed by the arrows of Arjuna, fell down on the earth.

sa: शुभाशुभं कर्म कृतं यदन्यत् तदेव प्रत्याददते स्वदेहे। मनोऽनुवर्तन्ति परावराणि जलौकसः स्रोत इवानुकूलम्॥
en: The actor in his new body receives all the good and bad acts done by him here, as also all acts done by him in his pristine existence. All these acts done in this life and the next ones follow the mind even as aquatic animals pass along a current.

sa: विमिश्रा विहगाः पुंभिरात्मव्यूहाभिनन्दिताः। भृङ्गराजप्रमुदिताः सौमित्रे मधुरस्वराः॥
en: O Saumitri, birds and bees of melodious notes accompanied by their co-mates and delighted with their mutual companionship are on the banks of this lake.

sa: न स्वयं कामकारेण तां त्यक्त्वाहमिहागतः। प्रचोदितस्तयैवोग्रैस्त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः॥
en: I have not come hither, of my own accord, renouncing Sītā; but I have come to you, having been urged thereto by herself with rudeness.

sa: पद्धवैरास्ततो द्रोणे धनंजयजयैषिणा। भारद्वाजसुतस्तेषु दृढवैरो महारथः॥
en: Solicitious of Dhanajaya's victory, the Panchalas were Drona's implacable foes, so also that mighty car-warrior the son of Bharadvaja was an inveterate enemy of theirs.

sa: भूरिदुमलतागुल्मं शुष्केन्धनतृणोलपम्॥ निर्दहेदनलोऽरण्यं यथा वायुसमीरितः। सेनारण्यं तव तथा कृष्णानिलसमीरितः॥ शरार्चिरदहत् क्रुद्धः पाण्डवाग्निर्धनंजयः।
en: Just as fire helped forwarded by the wind, burns down a forest abounding in trees, creepers, brush-woods, dry fuels and grass, so, that fire viz., the enraged Dhananjaya, the son of Pandu, having arrows for his flames and helped forward by the Krishna-wind, consumed the forest constituted by your troops.

sa: साध्वेनमधिरोहन्तु सर्वतो वानरर्षभाः। यूथपाश्च यथा मुख्यास्तिष्ठन्त्वस्मिन्समन्ततः॥
en: Now let the foremost monkeys, putting forth their best mount on him; and let the leaders of bands according to their rank, stand surrounding him.

sa: समुदीरितवीर्यास्ते समारोपितविक्रमाः। पर्यवस्थापिता वाक्यैरङ्गदेन बलीयसा ॥
en: Attaining energy at the exhortation (of Angada), and summoning up their prowess, they stayed in the field agreeable to the words of the powerful Angada.

sa: मेदोरुधिरयुक्तैश्च च्छिन्नबाहूरुपाणिभिः। निकृत्तोदरपादैश्च तत्र तत्र प्रवेरितैः॥
en: Human corpses were scattered over it, smeared with fat and blood, with arms and thighs out off, or with entrails torn out and legs severed.

sa: अतर्पयच्च विविधैर्वसुभिर्ब्राह्मणांस्तदा। प्रसर्पकाले सम्प्राप्ते नानादिग्भ्यः समागतान्॥
en: At the conclusion of the sacrifice, the king gratified the Brahmanas that assembled there from various quarters with large presents of various kinds of wealth.

sa: तेऽवतीर्णमुपश्रुत्य विषयं श्वेतवाहनम्। प्रत्युद्ययुरमृष्यन्तो राजानः पाण्डवर्षभम्॥
en: Hearing that he of white horses had entered their territories, those Kshatriyas came out against him, unable to bear that foremost one of Pandu's race.

sa: संवृतः सिन्धुसौवीरैर्नखरप्रासयोधिभिः। अत्यन्तोपचितैः शूरैः फाल्गुनः परवीरहा॥
en: Behold the mighty Phalguna that destroyer of hostile heroes surrounded by the SindhuSouviras armed with lances and javelins and numbering countless heroes among their ranks.

sa: सहदेवस्ततो राजन् विमना: शरपीडितः। कर्णवाक्छरतप्तश्च जीवितानिरविद्यत॥
en: With his mind ill at ease, afflicted with darts and smitten with the words of Karna (poignant) as darts, Shahadeva lost all love for life.

sa: सध्वजः सपताकश्च सानुकर्षों महारथः। चतुःसादिसमायुक्तो मेघस्तनितनिःस्वनः॥
en: His mighty car furnished with a banner and ensign and bottom, and having clatter resembling the roaring of clouds, has four horsemen (attached to it).

sa: रूपवन्तमधीयानमेकमेकान्तचारिणम्। तस्यैव तपसा राजंस्तद् वनं तेजसाऽऽवृतम्॥
en: Who was exceedingly handsome and who was studying the Vedas in solitude. O king, the whole forest was covered with the effulgence of his asceticism.

sa: द्वयोः स्त्रियोर्गुणज्येष्ठस्तेषामासीधुधिष्ठिरः। धर्माधुधिष्ठिरो जज्ञे मारुताच्च वृकोदरः॥
en: In the wombs of his two wives. Yudhishthira was the son of the eldest. Yudhishthira was born of Dharma, Vrikodara Bhima was born of Maruta;

sa: साधु पृच्छ नरश्रेष्ठ वाल्मीकिं मुनिपुङ्गवम्। शत्रुघ्नस्त्वब्रवीत्सर्वान्कौतूहलसमन्वितान्॥ सैनिकानक्षमोऽस्माकं परिप्रष्टुमिहेदृशः। आश्चर्याणि बहूनीह भवन्त्यस्याश्रमे मुनेः॥
en: O foremost of men, do you ask particularly, about this, Vālmīki, the foremost of ascetics. They being all thus struck with curiosity, Satrughna said: It is not proper for us, O You soldiers, to question him in this way. There are many such wonders in the hermitage of this ascetic.

sa: कच्चिद् विद्याविनीतांश्च नराज्ञानविशारदान्। यथार्ह गुणतश्चैव दानेनाभ्युपपद्यसे॥
en: Surely you reward by bestowing wealth and proper honors on men of learning and humility, and men who are skilled in every kind of knowledge.

sa: निर्दिष्टा भवतां पत्नी कृष्णा पार्षत्यनिन्दिता। पाञ्चालनगरे तस्मान्निवसध्वं महाबलाः। सुखिनस्तामनुप्राप्य भविष्यथ न संशयः॥
en: That faultless Krishna, the descendant of Prishata; is destined to be the wife of all of you (the five Pandavas). O greatly powerful heroes, go to the city of the Panchalas and live there. There is no doubt you will all be very happy on obtaining her as your wife.

sa: आमन्त्र्य ब्राह्मणं पूर्वमभिवाद्यानुमान्य च। समैरुदडमुखैर्मागैर्यथोद्दिष्टं परंतपाः॥
en: Those chastisers of foes proceeded in a northerly direction in order to reach their destination. They walked day and night and reached (the several) Somashrama.

sa: वशे शस्त्रप्रतापेन कुर्वन्तोऽन्यान्महीभृतः। एवं धर्मप्रधानास्ते सत्यव्रतपरायणाः॥
en: They brought by the force of their arms many chiefs and potentates under their subjugation. Setting their hearts on virtue and firmly adhering to truth,

sa: सिद्धचारणसंधैश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणैः। सेवितं वनमत्यर्थं मत्तवानरकिन्नरम्॥
en: It was the abode of the Siddhas, the Charanas, the various sorts of Gandharvas, the Apsaras, the monkeys and the Kinnaras, all drunk with joy.

sa: मेघच्छायोपगूढस्तु ततोऽदृश्यत फाल्गुनः। सूर्यातपपरिक्षिप्तः कर्णोऽपि समदृश्यत॥
en: Falguni (Arjuna) was invisible under cover of the clouds, but Karna was visible on account of the clouds being dispersed from him by the sun.

sa: सृष्ट्वा लोकांस्त्रीनिमान् हव्यवाह काले प्राप्ते पचसि पुनः समिद्धः। स्त्वमेवाग्ने भवसि पुनः प्रतिष्ठा॥
en: O carrier of (sacrificial) ghee (Agni), you create the three worlds and you again destroy them when the time comes for their destruction by swelling (your body to a fearful dimension). You are the progenerating mother of the whole universe; you are the essence also in which the universe dissolves.

sa: नाशक्नुवञ्छमयितुं तदाभूवन् पराङ्मुखाः। शतक्रतुस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य विमुखानमरांस्तथा।॥
en: O king, the deity of one hundred sacrifices (Indra),seeing the immortals retreat (from the battle), became exceedingly glad and much praised Keshava (Krishna) and Arjuna.

sa: तावन्तरिक्षमुत्प्लुत्य दैत्यौ कामगमावुभौ। देवानामेव भवनं जग्मतुर्युद्धदुर्मदौ॥
en: Furious in war and capable of going everywhere at will, the two Danavas rose to the sky and went to the region of the celestials.

sa: ततोऽन्योन्यमवैक्षन्त व्रीडयावनताननाः। तस्या योगमविन्दन्तो भृशं चोत्कण्द्दिताभवन्॥
en: Then they stared at one another, their faces flushed with blushes of shame. They were filled with great anxiety finding no means of recovering it.

sa: मनस्युरभवत् तस्माच्छूरसेनीसुतः प्रभुः। पृथिव्याश्चतुरन्ताया गोप्ता राजीवलोचनः॥
en: Pravira begot on his wife Shuraseni, a son named Manasyu. This lotus-eyed king had his sovereignty over the whole earth bounded by the four seas.

sa: धर्मक्रिया यज्ञशीलाः सत्यव्रतपरायणाः। अन्योन्यप्रीतिसंयुक्ता व्यवर्धन्त प्रजास्तदा॥
en: The people were devoted to virtuous acts, sacrifices and the vow of the truth. Bearing love and affection for one another, they grew in prosperity.

sa: शीतमारुतसंयुक्तं जगामान्यन्महद् वनम्। पुष्पितैः पादपैः कीर्णमतीव सुखशाद्वलम्॥ विपुलं मधुरारावैर्नादितं विहगैस्तथा। पुंस्कोकिलनिनादैश्च झिल्लीकगणनादितम्॥
en: It was cool and it breathed delightful breeze. It was full of trees covered with flowers. It extended far and wide in green soft grass. It echoed with the sweet songs of the birds. It resounded with the sweet notes of the male Kokila and the shrill cries of cicadas.

sa: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण चामरव्यजनेन च। सर्ववादित्रनादैश्च समलञ्चक्रिरे ततः॥
en: With the white umbrella held, over the hearse, with waving yak tails, with sounds of various musical instruments, the whole scene looked bright and grand.

sa: एकवर्षान्तरास्वेते द्रौपदेया यशस्विनः। अन्वजायन्त राजेन्द्र परस्परहितैषिणः॥
en: The sons of Draupadi were all born each at the interval of year. all of them became renowned and was much attached to one another.

sa: नानाविहगसंघुष्टं नानादंष्ट्रिसमाकुलम्। किन्नरैरप्सरोभिश्च देवैरपि च सेवितम्॥
en: On it do many birds pour forth their melody and may beasts of prey roam about; it is frequented by the Kinnaras, Apsaras and। celestials.

sa: स्रग्विणो दिव्यगन्धाश्च दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनाः। आदित्यास्तत्र वरुणं जलेश्वरमुपासते॥
en: Adorned with celestials garlands, perfumed with celestials scents and besmeared with paste of celestials fragrance, the Adityas wait there upon the lord of waters Varuna.

sa: राज्ञामागमनं चैव सार्हणानां महाक्रतौ। राजसूयेऽर्धसंवादे शिशुपालवधस्तथा॥
en: The arrival of the chiefs and potentates with tribute at the Rajasuya Yajna; the destruction of Shishupala at the sacrifice, in connection with Arghya giving;

sa: महर्मन्दपालस्य शाङ्गयां तनयसंभवः। इत्येतदादिपर्वोक्तं प्रथमं बहुविस्तरम्॥
en: The giving birth to son by Rishi Mandapala in the womb of a bird, called Sharangi. The Adi-Parva has been described with these various matters.

sa: विनतोवाच समुद्रकुक्षावेकान्ते निषादालयमुत्तमम्। निषादानां सहस्राणि तान्भुक्त्वाऽमृतमानय॥
en: Vinata said: The Nishadas have their homes in a remote place in the midst of the ocean. Eat thousands of Nishadas and bring the Ambrosia.

sa: यज्ञविद्याङ्गविद्भिश्च यजुर्विद्भिश्च शोभितम्। मधुरैः सामगीतैश्च ऋषिभिर्नियतव्रतैः॥ भारुण्डसामगीताभिरथर्वशिरसोद्गतः। यतात्मभिः सुनियतैः शुशुभे स तदाश्रमः॥
en: That hermitage was beautified with Brahmanas, learned in the Angas of Yajnavidya, reciting the hymns of Yajur-veda, The Rishis of rigid vows were reciting Saman hymns in harmonious strains. That time the hermitage aorned with Brahmanas who controlled their senses were reciting the Saman songs of Atharvashiras known as Bharunda.

sa: रथानां काञ्चनाङ्गानां किरूिणीजालमालिनाम्। चतुर्युजामुपेतानां सूतैः कुशलशिक्षितैः॥
en: (He gave the Pandavas) one thousand golden cars adorned with rows of bells, to each of which were yoked four steeds driven by well-trained charioteers.

sa: बभूवात्र महानादो महामेघरवोपमः। उदधेर्मथ्यमानस्य मन्दरेण सुरासुरैः॥
en: There rose from Mandara being dragged by the Devas and the Danavas, a terrible roar like the roar of the clouds (at the Universal dissolution).

sa: वीर्यवन्तोऽवलिप्तास्ते नानारूपधरा महीम्। इमां सागरपर्यन्तां परीयुररिमर्दनाः॥
en: Possessed of great prowess, they covered the earth in various shapes. They, becoming great oppressors, filled the earth to the very shores of the sea.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षिदेवगन्धर्वयक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः। करान् मम प्रयच्छन्ति सर्वे त्रैलोक्यवासिनः॥
en: The Brahmarshis, the celestials, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Pannagas and all the inhabitants of the three worlds had to pay me taxes.

sa: खङ्गशक्तिधनुाहा नद्यः शोणितसंस्रवाः। नृकलेवरवाहिन्यः प्रवृत्ताः सर्वतोदिशम्॥
en: On all sides there flowed streams of blood and there were afloat human bodies. Daggers, Saktis and bows were like the banks of the river.

sa: ततः कृच्छत्समासाद्य संज्ञां राक्षसपुङ्गवः। कुम्भकर्णवधाद्दीनो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः॥
en: Then regaining his senses with extreme exertion, that foremost of Rākṣasas, distressed in consequence of the destruction of Kumbhakarna, mourned with his senses overwhelmed, saying.

sa: बन्धुपक्षभयादीता लज्जया च यशस्विनी। तामर्कः पुनरेवेदमब्रवीद्भरतर्षभ॥
en: Did not grant his request from modesty and from the fear of her relatives. O best of the Bharata race, Arka again addressed her thus.

sa: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरो दिव्यगन्धविभूषितः। दिव्याङ्गदधरो नित्यं देवलोके महीयते॥
en: Wearing celestial garland sand dresses, and decked with celestial unguents and always shedding a celestial fragrance around, he receives great honours I then celestial region.
